spoken_transcript: China's AI industry is attracting growing global attention. Its open-source models are now widely adopted by businesses and researchers across the globe. So, why are a growing number of individuals and organizations choosing Chinese AI? Part of the answer lies in China's pace of innovation. Over the past years, Chinese companies have continued to introduce new generations of AI models. Several Chinese open-source models now rank among the world's leading performers in coding and AI agent evaluations, while delivering stronger performance at lower deployment costs. But China's AI story is about more than building better models. More Chinese companies are choosing to open-source their AI models, making advanced AI more accessible to developers, researchers and businesses around the world. Meanwhile, China's AI is rapidly moving beyond the laboratory and into the real economy, driving innovation across manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, robotics and smart mobility. As China's AI continues to evolve, another question is becoming just as important: How can more people benefit from AI? A key part of the answer is China's persistent commitment to a people-centered vision of AI that serves the common good, to deeper international collaboration, and to sharing the dividends of AI progress with more countries, industries, and citizens. As the World Artificial Intelligence Conference prepares to open in Shanghai, China hopes to share not only its latest advances in AI, but also its commitment to open collaboration and shared innovation. Because innovation creates greater value when it is shared, and the future of AI is brighter when it benefits everyone.
main_topics: التعاون الدولي وحوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي (مؤتمر WAIC في شنغهاي)
characters_present: باحثون وعلماء في مختبرات التقنية والتصنيع
communication_strategy: إقناع وإعلام عبر الاستشهاد ببيانات إحصائية وتقارير غربية موثوقة (رويترز، CNBC، RAND) لإبراز التفوق الصيني ومزاياه الاقتصادية والتشاركية.
cultural_interpreter_tactics: استخدام رموز مألوفة عالمياً (شاشات الرقائق الذكية، المصانع المؤتمتة، الاقتباسات الصحفية الدولية) لتقديم الصين كقوة ابتكار تشاركية تسعى لتحقيق الخير العام للبشرية.
ideological_discourse: التأكيد المكثف على إيجابيات الذات (الريادة التقنية، الكفاءة، خفض التكاليف، الرؤية المرتكزة على خدمة الإنسان ومشاركة مكاسب التنمية والتعاون المفتوح مع العالم).
body_language: ملامح تركيز واحترافية عالية من العاملين والباحثين، وتعبيرات انسجام وتعاون جماعي تظهر من خلال لقطات توقيع الاتفاقيات والتصفيق والمصافحة الرمزية بين الإنسان والروبوت.
